# Figure 3A - Shannon diversity
```{r}
############################################################
# Bacterial–Viral Alpha Diversity Comparison (First-Draw)
############################################################
# ============================================================
# 0. Clean workspace & load packages
# ============================================================
library(vegan)    
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)


# ============================================================
# 1. Function to compute alpha diversity
# ============================================================
# Reads a count table and computes Shannon, Simpson, and richness per sample.
Bacteria <- read_delim("METABAT.refined.bins.coverm.count.tsv") 
Virus <- read.delim("filtered_VPs_read_count_table.tsv")

compute_alpha <- function(file_path) {

  dat <- read_tsv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  # Genome names as rownames
  rownames(dat) <- dat$Genome

  # Transpose to sample × genome matrix
  mat <- t(dat[, -1])

  # Compute alpha diversity metrics
  data.frame(
    Sample   = rownames(mat),
    Shannon  = diversity(mat, index = "shannon"),
    Simpson  = diversity(mat, index = "simpson"),
    Richness = specnumber(mat)
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 2. Sample metadata mapping
# ============================================================
# Maps internal sample IDs to site, day, type, and filtration metadata used across analyses.
sample_mapping <- data.frame(
  Sample = c(
    "Sample1","Sample2","Sample3","Sample4","Sample5","Sample6",
    "Sample7","Sample8","Sample9","Sample10","Sample14","Sample16"
  ),
  Sample_name = c(
    "DS02_UF_fd_1","DS11_UF_fd_1","DS01_UF_fd_1","DS02_UF_fd_2",
    "DS11_UF_fd_2","DS01_UF_fd_2","DW11_UF_fd_3","DS01_UF_fd_3",
    "DS01_UF_ds_2","DS01_UF_ds_3","DS01_22_ds_4","DS02_UF_fd_3"
  ),
  sites = c(2,11,1,2,11,1,11,1,1,1,1,2),
  day   = c(1,1,1,2,2,2,3,3,2,3,4,3),
  type  = c("FD","FD","FD","FD","FD","FD","FD","FD","DS","DS","DS","FD"),
  filter = c("UF","UF","UF","UF","UF","UF","UF","UF","UF","UF","0.22um","UF")
)


# ============================================================
# 3. Bacterial MAG alpha diversity
# ============================================================
alpha_bacteria <- compute_alpha(
  "METABAT.refined.bins.coverm.count.tsv"
) %>%
  left_join(sample_mapping, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    sites = factor(
      sites,
      levels = c(1, 2, 11),
      labels = c("Site A", "Site B", "Site E")
    ),
      day = factor(
      day,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
      labels = c("Day 1", "Day 4", "Day 5", "Day 6")
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 4. Viral population alpha diversity
# ============================================================
alpha_viral <- compute_alpha(
  "filtered_VPs_read_count_table.tsv"
) %>%
  left_join(sample_mapping, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(
    sites = factor(
      sites,
      levels = c(1, 2, 11),
      labels = c("DS01", "DS02", "DS11")
    ),
    day = factor(
      day,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
      labels = c("Day 1", "Day 4", "Day 5", "Day 6")
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 5. Merge bacterial and viral alpha diversity
# ============================================================
# Combines bacterial and viral metrics per sample and restricts analysis to first-draw samples.
merged <- alpha_bacteria %>%
  rename(
    Bac_Shannon = Shannon,
    Bac_Simpson = Simpson
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    alpha_viral %>%
      rename(
        Viral_Shannon = Shannon,
        Viral_Simpson = Simpson
      ) %>%
      select(Sample, Viral_Shannon, Viral_Simpson),
    by = "Sample"
  ) %>%
  filter(type == "FD") %>%
  mutate(
    Site = factor(
      sites,
      levels = c("Site A", "Site B", "Site E")
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 6. Prepare data for faceted plotting
# ============================================================
plot_data_long <- merged %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Bac_Shannon, Viral_Shannon, Bac_Simpson, Viral_Simpson),
    names_to = c("Community", "Metric"),
    names_sep = "_",
    values_to = "Diversity"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Community,
    values_from = Diversity
  )

# ============================================================
# 7. Final faceted scatter plot
# ============================================================
# Compares bacterial vs viral alpha diversity across sites.
alpha_shannon <- ggplot(
  filter(plot_data_long, Metric == "Shannon"),
  aes(x = Bac, y = Viral, fill = Site)
) +
  geom_point(size = 4, shape = 21, stroke = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = viridis(3, end = 0.9)) +
  labs(
    x = "MAG Shannon Diversity",
    y = "vOTU Shannon Diversity"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

alpha_shannon

#ggsave("alpha.pdf", plot = alpha, width = 3, height = 4, device = "pdf")

```

# Figure 3B - total NTM concentration
```{r}
############################################################
# NTM Total MAG Concentration Over Time (First-Draw Samples)
############################################################
# ==========================================================
# Load required libraries
# ==========================================================
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(viridis)


# ==========================================================
# 1. Load and inspect NTM MAG abundance data
# ==========================================================
ntm <- read.table(
  "NTM_MAGs_results.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Remove rows with missing values
ntm <- na.omit(ntm)

# ==========================================================
# 2. Load water chemistry metadata
# ==========================================================
chemistry <- read.csv(
  "A2VS sample  - Sheet1_2.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 3. Merge abundance data with chemistry metadata
# ==========================================================
ntm <- ntm %>%
  left_join(chemistry, by = "sample")


# ==========================================================
# 4. Format Day and Site variables
# ==========================================================
# Convert numeric Day to labeled factor (Day 1, Day 2, etc.)
ntm$Day <- factor(
  ntm$Day,
  levels = sort(unique(ntm$Day)),
  labels = paste("Day", sort(unique(ntm$Day)))
)

# Recode Site IDs to readable labels
ntm$Site <- fct_recode(
  ntm$Site,
  "Site A" = "DS1",
  "Site B" = "DS2",
  "Site E" = "DS11"
)

# Explicit Site ordering for plotting
ntm$Site <- factor(
  ntm$Site,
  levels = c("Site A", "Site B", "Site E")
)


# ==========================================================
# 5. Summarize total MAG concentration (gc/L)
# ==========================================================
# First-draw samples only
fd_total <- ntm %>%
  filter(Type == "fd") %>%
  group_by(Site, Day) %>%
  summarise(
    total_gcL = sum(gc_L),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(log10_gcL = log10(total_gcL))

# ==========================================================
# 6. Relabel Day values to reflect actual sampling days
# ==========================================================
fd_total <- fd_total %>%
  mutate(
    Day = recode(
      Day,
      "Day 1" = "Day 1",
      "Day 2" = "Day 3",
      "Day 3" = "Day 7"
    )
  )


# ==========================================================
# 7. Plot total NTM concentration over time (first-draw)
# ==========================================================
total_NTM <- ggplot(
  fd_total,
  aes(
    x = Day,
    y = log10_gcL,
    fill = Site,
    group = Site
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +   # thicker line
  geom_point(
    size = 5,
    shape = 21,
    stroke = 0.5,
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = viridisLite::viridis(3, end = 0.9)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(4.5, 6.5),
    breaks = seq(4, 6.5, by = 0.5)
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Total NTM concentration (log10(copies/L))",
    color = "Site"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
total_NTM

```

# Figure 3D - NTM speciation
```{r}
############################################################
# NTM MAG Absolute Abundance Visualization
############################################################


# ==========================================================
# Load required libraries
# ==========================================================
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(viridis)


# ==========================================================
# 1. Load input data
# ==========================================================
# NTM MAG absolute abundance results
ntm <- read.table(
  "NTM_MAGs_results.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Water chemistry metadata for sample name 
chemistry <- read.csv(
  "A2VS sample  - Sheet1_2.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 2. Basic cleaning and merging
# ==========================================================
# Remove rows with missing values
ntm <- na.omit(ntm)

# Merge NTM data with chemistry metadata by sample ID
ntm <- ntm %>%
  left_join(chemistry, by = "sample")


# ==========================================================
# 3. Format Day and Site variables
# ==========================================================
# Convert Day to a labeled factor (Day 1, Day 2, etc.)
ntm$Day <- factor(
  ntm$Day,
  levels = sort(unique(ntm$Day)),
  labels = paste("Day", sort(unique(ntm$Day)))
)

# Recode Site IDs to human-readable labels
ntm$Site <- fct_recode(
  ntm$Site,
  "Site A" = "DS1",
  "Site B" = "DS2",
  "Site E" = "DS11"
)


# ==========================================================
# 4. Map MAG contig IDs to species names
# ==========================================================
MAG_lookup <- data.frame(
  Contig = c(
    "METABAT_107-contigs",
    "METABAT_121-contigs_2",
    "METABAT_44-contigs_1",
    "METABAT_128-contigs",
    "METABAT_139-contigs",
    "METABAT_193-contigs_1",
    "METABAT_311-contigs"
  ),
  name = c(
    "M. gordonae",
    "M. avium",
    "M. paragordonae",
    "M. llatzerense",
    "M. phocaicum",
    "M. gadium",
    "M. arupense"
  )
)


# ==========================================================
# 5. Create plotting-ready dataset
# ==========================================================
ntm2 <- ntm %>%
  left_join(MAG_lookup, by = c("bin" = "Contig")) %>%
  mutate(
    MAG_name = ifelse(!is.na(name), name, bin),
    log_gcL  = log10(gc_L)
  )

# Explicit Site order
ntm2$Site <- factor(
  ntm2$Site,
  levels = c("Site A", "Site B", "Site E")
)

# Recode and order sample Type
ntm2$Type <- recode(
  ntm2$Type,
  "fd" = "first-draw",
  "ds" = "full-flush"
)

# Relabel Day values to reflect sampling schedule
ntm2 <- ntm2 %>%
  mutate(
    Day = recode(
      Day,
      "Day 1" = "Day 1",
      "Day 2" = "Day 3",
      "Day 3" = "Day 7",
      "Day 4" = "Day 8"
    )
  )


# ==========================================================
# 6. Subset to first-draw samples only
# ==========================================================
ntm2_filtered <- ntm2 %>%
  filter(Type == "first-draw")


# ==========================================================
# 7. Bubble plot: first-draw samples (color only)
# ==========================================================
NTM_speciation <- ggplot(ntm2_filtered, aes(x = Day, y = MAG_name, color = log_gcL)) +
  geom_point(size = 9) +
  facet_wrap(~ Site, ncol = 4) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", end = 0.9) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    color = "log10(copies/L)"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),   # remove major grid
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),   # remove minor grid
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black", face = "italic"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

NTM_speciation

ggsave("NTM_speciation.pdf", plot = NTM_speciation, width = 13, height = 4, device = "pdf")


```

# Figure 4 - NTM KEGG ID
```{r}
############################################################
# Gene-level KO Abundance Analysis and Categorized Bubble Plot
############################################################


# ==========================================================
# Load required libraries
# ==========================================================
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)


# ==========================================================
# 1. Load gene-level gc/L results
# ==========================================================
# This file contains gene-level absolute abundance (copies/L) across samples and MAGs.
gcl <- read_csv("NTM_gene_gcL_results.csv")

# Construct a consistent gene identifier by combining contig name and gene number extracted from GeneID
gcl <- gcl %>%
  mutate(
    Gene_number = sub(".*_", "", GeneID),
    Geneid_full = paste0(Chr, "_", Gene_number)
  )

# Keep essential columns and standardize MAG names
gcl_clean <- gcl %>%
  select(Geneid_full, MAG, Sample, gene_gcL) %>%
  mutate(
    MAG = gsub("^METABAT_([0-9]+).*", "MAG_\\1", MAG)
  )


# ==========================================================
# 2. Load GhostKOALA KO annotations (per MAG)
# ==========================================================
# Each file contains KO annotations for one MAG.
colnames_list <- c(
  "Geneid_full", "KO", "Definition",
  "score", "second_best", "second_score"
)

ghost_44  <- read.delim("user_ko_definition-44.txt",  header = FALSE) %>% setNames(colnames_list) %>% mutate(MAG = "MAG_44")
ghost_107 <- read.delim("user_ko_definition-107.txt", header = FALSE) %>% setNames(colnames_list) %>% mutate(MAG = "MAG_107")
ghost_121 <- read.delim("user_ko_definition-121.txt", header = FALSE) %>% setNames(colnames_list) %>% mutate(MAG = "MAG_121")
ghost_128 <- read.delim("user_ko_definition-128.txt", header = FALSE) %>% setNames(colnames_list) %>% mutate(MAG = "MAG_128")
ghost_139 <- read.delim("user_ko_definition-139.txt", header = FALSE) %>% setNames(colnames_list) %>% mutate(MAG = "MAG_139")
ghost_193 <- read.delim("user_ko_definition-193.txt", header = FALSE) %>% setNames(colnames_list) %>% mutate(MAG = "MAG_193")
ghost_311 <- read.delim("user_ko_definition-311.txt", header = FALSE) %>% setNames(colnames_list) %>% mutate(MAG = "MAG_311")

# Combine all KO annotations into a single table
ghost_all <- bind_rows(
  ghost_44,
  ghost_107,
  ghost_121,
  ghost_128,
  ghost_139,
  ghost_193,
  ghost_311
) %>%
  select(Geneid_full, KO, Definition, MAG)


# ==========================================================
# 3. Merge KO annotations with gene-level gc/L data
# ==========================================================
# The resulting table contains gene abundance, KO annotation, functional definition, and MAG identity.
merged <- gcl_clean %>%
  left_join(ghost_all, by = c("Geneid_full", "MAG"))


# ==========================================================
# 4. Summarize KO abundance per MAG
# ==========================================================
# Gene-level gc/L values are averaged across samples at the KO level within each MAG.
ko_summary <- merged %>%
  filter(!is.na(KO), KO != "") %>%
  group_by(MAG, KO, Definition) %>%
  summarise(
    Average_gcL = mean(gene_gcL, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ==========================================================
# 5. Create a complete MAG × KO matrix
# ==========================================================
ko_mag_avg <- merged %>%
  filter(!is.na(KO), KO != "") %>%
  group_by(MAG, KO, Definition) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_gcL = mean(gene_gcL, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

all_MAGs <- sort(unique(merged$MAG))
all_KOs  <- sort(unique(ko_mag_avg$KO))

ko_mag_complete <- ko_mag_avg %>%
  complete(
    MAG = all_MAGs,
    KO = all_KOs,
    fill = list(avg_gcL = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(KO) %>%
  fill(Definition, .direction = "downup") %>%
  ungroup()


# ==========================================================
# 6. Identify the top 20 KOs across all MAGs
# ==========================================================
top20_kos <- ko_mag_complete %>%
  group_by(KO, Definition) %>%
  summarise(
    global_avg = mean(avg_gcL),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(global_avg)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)


# ==========================================================
# 7. Prepare data for bubble plot
# ==========================================================
bubble_df <- ko_mag_complete %>%
  filter(KO %in% top20_kos$KO) %>%
  mutate(
    KO_ID_clean = Definition,
    MAG = factor(MAG, levels = unique(merged$MAG))
  )


# ==========================================================
# 8. Map MAG IDs to species names
# ==========================================================
mag_species_map <- c(
  "MAG_107" = "M. gordonae",
  "MAG_121" = "M. avium",
  "MAG_44"  = "M. paragordonae",
  "MAG_128" = "M. llatzerense",
  "MAG_139" = "M. phocaicum",
  "MAG_193" = "M. gadium",
  "MAG_311" = "M. arupense"
)

bubble_df$MAG <- factor(
  mag_species_map[as.character(bubble_df$MAG)],
  levels = mag_species_map
)


# ==========================================================
# 9. Compute log10-transformed abundance for visualization
# ==========================================================
bubble_df <- bubble_df %>%
  mutate(log10_gcL = log10(avg_gcL + 1))


# ==========================================================
# 10. Define KO ordering and clean KO labels
# ==========================================================
# Remove trailing EC annotations and enforce an KO ordering for the y-axis.
bubble_df$KO_ID_clean <- gsub(
  "\\s*\\[EC:[^]]+\\]\\s*$",
  "",
  as.character(bubble_df$Definition)
)

ko_order <- c(
  "secA; preprotein translocase subunit SecA",
  "trbE; type IV secretion system protein TrbE",
  "carB, CPA2; carbamoyl-phosphate synthase large subunit",
  "gltB; glutamate synthase (NADPH) large chain",
  "metH, MTR; 5-methyltetrahydrofolate--homocysteine methyltransferase",
  "AHCY, ahcY; adenosylhomocysteinase",
  "aceE; pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 component",
  "acnA; aconitate hydratase A / 2-methylisocitrate dehydratase",
  "fas; fatty acid synthase, bacteria type",
  "pks5; polyketide synthase 5",
  "pks12; mycoketide-CoA synthase",
  "pks13; polyketide synthase 13",
  "accA2; acyl-CoA carboxylase subunit alpha",
  "clpB; ATP-dependent Clp protease ATP-binding subunit ClpB",
  "ettA; energy-dependent translational throttle protein EttA",
  "rpoB; DNA-directed RNA polymerase subunit beta",
  "rpoC; DNA-directed RNA polymerase subunit beta'",
  "uvrA; excinuclease ABC subunit A",
  "mfd; transcription-repair coupling factor (superfamily II helicase)",
  "lhr; ATP-dependent helicase Lhr and Lhr-like helicase"
)

bubble_df$KO_ID_clean <- factor(
  bubble_df$KO_ID_clean,
  levels = ko_order
)


# ==========================================================
# 11. Assign functional categories to KOs
# ==========================================================
ko_category <- c(
  "secA; preprotein translocase subunit SecA" = "Secretion system",
  "trbE; type IV secretion system protein TrbE" = "Secretion system",

  "carB, CPA2; carbamoyl-phosphate synthase large subunit" = "Other metabolism",
  "gltB; glutamate synthase (NADPH) large chain" = "Other metabolism",
  "metH, MTR; 5-methyltetrahydrofolate--homocysteine methyltransferase" = "Other metabolism",
  "AHCY, ahcY; adenosylhomocysteinase" = "Other metabolism",
  "aceE; pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 component" = "Other metabolism",
  "acnA; aconitate hydratase A / 2-methylisocitrate dehydratase" = "Other metabolism",

  "fas; fatty acid synthase, bacteria type" = "Lipid metabolism",
  "pks5; polyketide synthase 5" = "Lipid metabolism",
  "pks12; mycoketide-CoA synthase" = "Lipid metabolism",
  "pks13; polyketide synthase 13" = "Lipid metabolism",
  "accA2; acyl-CoA carboxylase subunit alpha" = "Lipid metabolism",

  "clpB; ATP-dependent Clp protease ATP-binding subunit ClpB" = "Heat shock proteins",
  "ettA; energy-dependent translational throttle protein EttA" = "Heat shock proteins",

  "rpoB; DNA-directed RNA polymerase subunit beta" = "DNA repair and recombination proteins",
  "rpoC; DNA-directed RNA polymerase subunit beta'" = "DNA repair and recombination proteins",
  "uvrA; excinuclease ABC subunit A" = "DNA repair and recombination proteins",
  "mfd; transcription-repair coupling factor (superfamily II helicase)" = "DNA repair and recombination proteins",
  "lhr; ATP-dependent helicase Lhr and Lhr-like helicase" = "DNA repair and recombination proteins"
)

bubble_df$Category <- ko_category[bubble_df$KO_ID_clean]


# ==========================================================
# 12. Create KO category annotation plot
# ==========================================================
category_colors <- c(
  "Secretion system" = "#f6ddc6",
  "Other metabolism" = "#dff0d8",
  "Lipid metabolism" = "#ead1dc",
  "Heat shock proteins" = "#d9edf7",
  "DNA repair and recombination proteins" = "#fff59d"
)

anno_df <- bubble_df %>%
  distinct(KO_ID_clean, Category)

p_anno <- ggplot(
  anno_df,
  aes(x = 1, y = KO_ID_clean, fill = Category)
) +
  geom_tile(width = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = category_colors,
    name = "Gene category"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5)
  )

p_anno


# ==========================================================
# 14. Create heatmap
# ==========================================================
p_heatmap <- ggplot(
  bubble_df,
  aes(x = MAG, y = KO_ID_clean, fill = log10_gcL)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("white", viridis::plasma(50)),
    name = "log10(copies/L)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12, color = "black", face = "italic"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 0),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black")
  )

p_heatmap

# ==========================================================
# 15. Combine annotation and heatmap
# ==========================================================
p <- (p_anno + p_heatmap) +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(0.1, 1),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

#ggsave("NTM_KEGG_heatmap.pdf", plot = p, width = 11, height = 8, device = "pdf")

```

# Figure 5C - NTM plasmid KEGG ID 
```{r}
############################################################
# Plasmid KO Abundance Analysis and Visualization
############################################################


# ==========================================================
# Load required libraries
# ==========================================================
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(viridis)


# ==========================================================
# 1. Load plasmid gene gc/L results
# ==========================================================
# This file contains gene-level absolute abundance (copies/L) for plasmid-associated genes across samples.
plasmid_gcl <- read_csv("NTM_plasmid_gcL_results.csv")

# Create a consistent gene identifier by combining contig name and gene number extracted from GeneID
plasmid_gcl <- plasmid_gcl %>%
  mutate(
    Gene_number = sub(".*_", "", GeneID),
    Geneid_full = paste0(Chr, "_", Gene_number)
  )

# Keep only essential columns and standardize MAG names
plasmid_gcl_clean <- plasmid_gcl %>%
  select(Geneid_full, MAG, Sample, gene_gcL) %>%
  mutate(
    MAG = as.character(MAG),
    MAG = gsub("^METABAT_([0-9]+).*", "MAG_\\1", MAG)
  )


# ==========================================================
# 2. Load GhostKOALA KO annotations for plasmid genes
# ==========================================================
# This file maps plasmid genes to KEGG Orthologs (KOs) and functional definitions.
colnames_list <- c(
  "Geneid_full", "KO", "Definition",
  "score", "second_best", "second_score"
)

ghost_plasmid <- read.delim(
  "user_ko_definition_plasmid.txt",
  header = FALSE
) %>%
  setNames(colnames_list)


# ==========================================================
# 3. Load contig mapping file
# ==========================================================
# This file links original contig names to mapped contig names following dereplication or reassignment.
plasmid_map <- read.delim(
  "plasmid_full_hits_contig.tsv",
  header = FALSE,
  sep = ""
)

colnames(plasmid_map) <- c(
  "Original_Contig", "Mapped_Contig",
  "MAG", "Len1", "Len2", "Identity"
)


# ==========================================================
# 4. Fix contig names and reconcile gene IDs
# ==========================================================
# This step ensures that KO annotations match the gene IDs used in the gc/L file after contig renaming.
ghost_plasmid2 <- ghost_plasmid %>%
  mutate(
    Contig_base = sub("_[0-9]+$", "", Geneid_full)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    plasmid_map,
    by = c("Contig_base" = "Original_Contig")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    MAG = sub("^METABAT_([0-9]+).*", "MAG_\\1", MAG),
    Geneid_final = ifelse(
      !is.na(Mapped_Contig),
      paste0(
        Mapped_Contig,
        sub("^.*(_[0-9]+)$", "\\1", Geneid_full)
      ),
      Geneid_full
    )
  )


# ==========================================================
# 5. Merge KO annotations with gene-level gc/L data
# ==========================================================
# The resulting table contains gene abundance, KO annotation, functional definition, and MAG identity.
plasmid_merged <- plasmid_gcl_clean %>%
  left_join(
    ghost_plasmid2 %>%
      select(Geneid_final, KO, Definition, MAG),
    by = c("Geneid_full" = "Geneid_final", "MAG")
  )


# ==========================================================
# 6. Summarize KO abundance per MAG
# ==========================================================
# Gene-level gc/L values are averaged across samples at the KO level within each MAG.
plasmid_ko_summary <- plasmid_merged %>%
  filter(!is.na(KO), KO != "") %>%
  group_by(MAG, KO, Definition) %>%
  summarise(
    Average_gcL = mean(gene_gcL, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ==========================================================
# 7. Create a complete MAG × KO matrix
# ==========================================================
# This ensures that all MAG–KO combinations exist, with missing values filled as zero.
ko_plasmid_avg <- plasmid_merged %>%
  filter(!is.na(KO), KO != "") %>%
  group_by(MAG, KO, Definition) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_gcL = mean(gene_gcL, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

all_MAGs <- sort(unique(plasmid_merged$MAG))
all_KOs  <- sort(unique(ko_plasmid_avg$KO))

ko_plasmid_complete <- ko_plasmid_avg %>%
  complete(
    MAG = all_MAGs,
    KO = all_KOs,
    fill = list(avg_gcL = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(KO) %>%
  fill(Definition, .direction = "downup") %>%
  ungroup()


# ==========================================================
# 8. Identify the top 20 plasmid-associated KOs
# ==========================================================
# Top KOs are selected based on global average abundance across all MAGs.
top20_plasmid_kos <- ko_plasmid_complete %>%
  group_by(KO, Definition) %>%
  summarise(
    global_avg = mean(avg_gcL),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(global_avg)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

# ==========================================================
# 9. Prepare data for bubble plot
# ==========================================================
# Remove bracketed annotations (e.g., "[*]") from KO labels
bubble_df_plasmid <- ko_plasmid_complete %>%
  filter(KO %in% top20_plasmid_kos$KO) %>%
  mutate(
    KO_ID_clean = gsub("\\s*\\[.*?\\]", "", Definition),
    MAG = factor(MAG, levels = all_MAGs)
  )


# ==========================================================
# 10. Map MAG IDs to species names
# ==========================================================
mag_species_map <- c(
  "MAG_107" = "M. gordonae",
  "MAG_121" = "M. avium",
  "MAG_44"  = "M. paragordonae",
  "MAG_128" = "M. llatzerense",
  "MAG_139" = "M. phocaicum",
  "MAG_193" = "M. gadium",
  "MAG_311" = "M. arupense"
)

bubble_df_plasmid$MAG <- factor(
  mag_species_map[as.character(bubble_df_plasmid$MAG)],
  levels = mag_species_map
)


# ==========================================================
# 11. Compute log10-transformed abundance for visualization
# ==========================================================
bubble_df_plasmid <- bubble_df_plasmid %>%
  mutate(log10_gcL = log10(avg_gcL + 1))

ko_order <- c(
  "mycP; membrane-anchored mycosin MYCP",
  "eccC; ESX secretion system protein EccC",
  "ALDH; aldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+)",
  "gltB; glutamate synthase (NADPH) large chain",
  "gltD; glutamate synthase (NADPH) small chain", 
  "pntA; proton-translocating NAD(P)+ transhydrogenase subunit alpha",
  "pntB; proton-translocating NAD(P)+ transhydrogenase subunit beta",
  "cysNC; bifunctional enzyme CysN/CysC",
  "kstD; 3-oxosteroid 1-dehydrogenase",
  "fadD9; fatty acid CoA ligase FadD9",
  "pks5; polyketide synthase 5",
    "zntA; Zn2+/Cd2+-exporting ATPase",
  "K06994; putative drug exporter of the RND superfamily",
  "copA, ctpA, ATP7; P-type Cu+ transporter",
  "DNMT1, dcm; DNA (cytosine-5)-methyltransferase 1",
  "ftsK, spoIIIE; DNA segregation ATPase FtsK/SpoIIIE, S-DNA-T family",
  "recD; exodeoxyribonuclease V alpha subunit",
  "xerC; integrase/recombinase XerC",
  "IARS, ileS; isoleucyl-tRNA synthetase",
  "prkC, stkP; eukaryotic-like serine/threonine-protein kinase"
)

bubble_df_plasmid$KO_ID_clean <- factor(
  bubble_df_plasmid$KO_ID_clean,
  levels = ko_order
)


# ==========================================================
# 11. Assign functional categories to KOs
# ==========================================================
ko_category <- c(
  "mycP; membrane-anchored mycosin MYCP" = "Secretion system",
  "eccC; ESX secretion system protein EccC" = "Secretion system",
  "ALDH; aldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD+)" = "Other metabolism",
  "gltB; glutamate synthase (NADPH) large chain" = "Other metabolism",
  "gltD; glutamate synthase (NADPH) small chain" = "Other metabolism", 
  "pntA; proton-translocating NAD(P)+ transhydrogenase subunit alpha" = "Other metabolism",
  "pntB; proton-translocating NAD(P)+ transhydrogenase subunit beta" = "Other metabolism",
  "cysNC; bifunctional enzyme CysN/CysC" = "Other metabolism",
  "kstD; 3-oxosteroid 1-dehydrogenase" = "Other metabolism",
  "fadD9; fatty acid CoA ligase FadD9" = "Lipid metabolism",
  "pks5; polyketide synthase 5" = "Lipid metabolism",
    "zntA; Zn2+/Cd2+-exporting ATPase" = "Transporter",
  "K06994; putative drug exporter of the RND superfamily" = "Transporter",
  "copA, ctpA, ATP7; P-type Cu+ transporter" = "Transporter",
  "DNMT1, dcm; DNA (cytosine-5)-methyltransferase 1" = "Genetic information processing",
  "ftsK, spoIIIE; DNA segregation ATPase FtsK/SpoIIIE, S-DNA-T family" = "Genetic information processing",
  "recD; exodeoxyribonuclease V alpha subunit" = "Genetic information processing",
  "xerC; integrase/recombinase XerC" = "Genetic information processing",
  "IARS, ileS; isoleucyl-tRNA synthetase" = "Others",
  "prkC, stkP; eukaryotic-like serine/threonine-protein kinase" = "Others"
)

bubble_df_plasmid$Category <- ko_category[bubble_df_plasmid$KO_ID_clean]


# ==========================================================
# 12. Create KO category annotation plot
# ==========================================================
category_colors <- c(
  "Others" = "lightgrey",
  "Genetic information processing" = "goldenrod2",
  "Transporter" = "dodgerblue1",
  "Lipid metabolism" = "#ead1dc",
  "Other metabolism" = "#dff0d8",
  "Secretion system" = "#f6ddc6"
)

category <- c(
  "Others",
  "Genetic information processing",
  "Transporter",
  "Lipid metabolism",
  "Other metabolism",
  "Secretion system" 
)

anno_df <- bubble_df_plasmid %>%
  distinct(KO_ID_clean, Category)

anno_df$Category <- factor(
  anno_df$Category,
  levels = category
)

p_anno <- ggplot(
  anno_df,
  aes(x = 1, y = KO_ID_clean, fill = Category)
) +
  geom_tile(width = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = category_colors,
    name = "Gene category"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5)
  )

p_anno
# ==========================================================
# 14. Create heatmap
# ==========================================================
p_heatmap <- ggplot(
  bubble_df_plasmid,
  aes(x = MAG, y = KO_ID_clean, fill = log10_gcL)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("white", viridis::plasma(50)),
    name = "log10(copies/L)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12, color = "black", face = "italic"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 0),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black")
  )

p_heatmap

# ==========================================================
# 15. Combine annotation and heatmap
# ==========================================================
p <- (p_anno + p_heatmap) +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(0.1, 1),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

# Figure 5A - NTM prophage KEGG ID 
```{r}
############################################################
# Prophage KO Abundance Analysis and Visualization
############################################################

# ==========================================================
# Load required libraries
# ==========================================================
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(viridis)

# ==========================================================
# 1. Load prophage gene gc/L results
# ==========================================================
# This file contains gene-level absolute abundance (copies/L)
provirus_gcl <- read_csv("NTM_prophage_gcL_results.csv")

# Create a consistent gene identifier by combining contig name and gene number extracted from GeneID
provirus_gcl <- provirus_gcl %>%
  mutate(
    Gene_number = sub(".*_", "", GeneID),
    Geneid_full = paste0(Chr, "_", Gene_number)
  )

# Keep only essential columns and standardize MAG names
provirus_gcl_clean <- provirus_gcl %>%
  select(Geneid_full, MAG, Sample, gene_gcL) %>%
  mutate(
    MAG = as.character(MAG),
    MAG = gsub("^METABAT_([0-9]+).*", "MAG_\\1", MAG)
  )


# ==========================================================
# 2. Load GhostKOALA KO annotations for prophage genes
# ==========================================================
# This file maps genes to KEGG Orthologs (KOs) and definitions.
colnames_list <- c(
  "Geneid_full", "KO", "Definition",
  "score", "second_best", "second_score"
)

ghost_provirus <- read.delim(
  "user_ko_definition_provirus.txt",
  header = FALSE
) %>%
  setNames(colnames_list)


# ==========================================================
# 3. Load contig mapping file
# ==========================================================
# This file links original contig names to mapped contig names after dereplication or reassignment.
provirus_map <- read.delim(
  "provirus_full_hits_contig.tsv",
  header = FALSE,
  sep = ""
)

colnames(provirus_map) <- c(
  "Original_Contig", "Mapped_Contig",
  "MAG", "Len1", "Len2", "Identity"
)


# ==========================================================
# 4. Fix contig names and reconcile gene IDs
# ==========================================================
# This step ensures that KO annotations match the gene IDs used in the gc/L file after contig renaming.
ghost_provirus2 <- ghost_provirus %>%
  mutate(
    Contig_base = sub("_[0-9]+$", "", Geneid_full)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    provirus_map,
    by = c("Contig_base" = "Original_Contig")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    MAG = sub("^METABAT_([0-9]+).*", "MAG_\\1", MAG),
    Geneid_final = ifelse(
      !is.na(Mapped_Contig),
      paste0(
        Mapped_Contig,
        sub("^.*(_[0-9]+)$", "\\1", Geneid_full)
      ),
      Geneid_full
    )
  )


# ==========================================================
# 5. Merge KO annotations with gene-level gc/L data
# ==========================================================
# The resulting table contains gene abundance, KO annotation, functional definition, and MAG identity.
provirus_merged <- provirus_gcl_clean %>%
  left_join(
    ghost_provirus2 %>%
      select(Geneid_final, KO, Definition, MAG),
    by = c("Geneid_full" = "Geneid_final", "MAG")
  )


# ==========================================================
# 6. Summarize KO abundance per MAG
# ==========================================================
# Gene-level gc/L values were averaged across samples at the KO level within each MAG.
provirus_ko_summary <- provirus_merged %>%
  filter(!is.na(KO), KO != "") %>%
  group_by(MAG, KO, Definition) %>%
  summarise(
    Average_gcL = mean(gene_gcL, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ==========================================================
# 7. Create a complete MAG × KO matrix
# ==========================================================
# This ensures that all MAG–KO combinations exist, with missing values filled as zero.
ko_provirus_avg <- provirus_merged %>%
  filter(!is.na(KO), KO != "") %>%
  group_by(MAG, KO, Definition) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_gcL = mean(gene_gcL, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

all_MAGs <- sort(unique(provirus_merged$MAG))
all_KOs  <- sort(unique(ko_provirus_avg$KO))

ko_provirus_complete <- ko_provirus_avg %>%
  complete(
    MAG = all_MAGs,
    KO = all_KOs,
    fill = list(avg_gcL = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(KO) %>%
  fill(Definition, .direction = "downup") %>%
  ungroup()


# ==========================================================
# 8. Prepare data for bubble plot
# ==========================================================
# Remove bracketed annotations (e.g., "[*]") from KO labels
# Set the y-axis order manually
y_order <- c(
  "DNMT1, dcm; DNA (cytosine-5)-methyltransferase 1",
  "mcrA; 5-methylcytosine-specific restriction enzyme A",
  "mutY; A/G-specific adenine glycosylase",
    "dam; DNA adenine methylase",
  "xerC; integrase/recombinase XerC",
  "cpaF, tadA; pilus assembly protein CpaF",
  "PHB1; prohibitin 1"
)


bubble_df_provirus <- ko_provirus_complete %>%
  mutate(
    KO_ID_clean = gsub("\\s*\\[.*?\\]", "", Definition),
    MAG = factor(MAG, levels = all_MAGs)
  )

bubble_df_provirus <- bubble_df_provirus %>%
  mutate(KO_ID_clean = factor(KO_ID_clean, levels = y_order))

# ==========================================================
# 9. Map MAG IDs to species names
# ==========================================================
mag_species_map <- c(
  "MAG_107" = "M. gordonae",
  "MAG_121" = "M. avium",
  "MAG_44"  = "M. paragordonae",
  "MAG_128" = "M. llatzerense",
  "MAG_139" = "M. phocaicum",
  "MAG_193" = "M. gadium",
  "MAG_311" = "M. arupense"
)

bubble_df_provirus$MAG <- factor(
  mag_species_map[as.character(bubble_df_provirus$MAG)],
  levels = mag_species_map
)


# ==========================================================
# 10. Compute log10-transformed abundance for visualization
# ==========================================================
bubble_df_provirus <- bubble_df_provirus %>%
  mutate(log10_gcL = log10(avg_gcL + 1))


# ==========================================================
# 12. Generate heatmap
# ==========================================================
# The plot shows the distribution and magnitude of the prophage-associated KOs across NTM species.
prophage <- ggplot(
  bubble_df_provirus,
  aes(x = MAG, y = KO_ID_clean, fill = log10_gcL)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("white", viridis::plasma(50)),
    values = scales::rescale(
      c(0, max(bubble_df_provirus$log10_gcL, na.rm = TRUE))
    ),
    name = "log10(copies/L)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black", face = "italic"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black")
  )

prophage
ggsave("NTM_prophage_heatmap.pdf", plot = prophage, width = 8, height = 5, device = "pdf")
```
